summary: Add a 'crowd' detection type: fires when at least minCount people (default 2) are detected inside the zone in a single frame. New shared vision logic (crowd.go) reusing the existing zone/threshold/minFrames/cooldown machinery, plus a Crowd rule type with a 'Minimum people' field in the vision rule editor.
compatibility: Backward compatible. New ruleConfig shape {"minCount": N} (N >= 2); existing rules unaffected. Crowd counts the 'person' class by default.
